EC1: Surgery [OR] and/or previous ocular pathology (presence of scar [OR]/change in the cornea [OR], glaucoma [OR], retinopathies, etc.).
EC2: Patient has diabetes [OR] or is immunodepressed.
EC3: Any systemic infection during the study.
EC4: Signs and/or symptoms of ocular inflammation [OR]/infection (bacterial [OR], viral [OR], fungal [OR], caused  by [OR] Chlamydia [OR], by Mycobacterium [OR], Acanthamoeba or of allergic etiology).
